messages:
alex: Planning a quick staging cutover: switch pod auth to k8s/GCP-bound Vault auth and enable KMS-wrapped audit blobs. Key: `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/audit-wrap-az1`. Canary window: 2026-06-10 19:00 UTC (15m) -> full at 19:30 UTC. Need RBAC signoff, KMS IAM grant, and a short list of long-lived creds to rotate. Who's in?

mei: I can take RBAC review. Please scope the canary to namespace `staging-ml` and post the RoleBinding diff.

tony: I'll own KMS IAM binding. Plan: create `serviceAccount:vault-audit@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` -> `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. Will run encrypt/decrypt test in staging before enabling.

security-bot: ALERT: add an audit detection for vault auth failures. Suggested query: `index=audit-vault-* AND json.event_type:auth AND json.status:401 | stats count() by json.client_token`. Trigger threshold: 3 failures/sec sustained 1m.

ops: Runbook added: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/runbooks/vault-k8s-kms-cutover. Revert manifest is saved at `infra/manifests/vault-revert-2026-06-10.yaml`.

alex: Checklist:
- By 16:00 UTC: publish svcaccounts + long-lived creds owners.
- Mei: post RBAC diff and request @maria review.
- Tony: open KMS PR (do-not-apply tag) + run staging decrypt smoke.
- Canary (19:00, 15m): enable k8s auth for `staging-ml` only and point audithook to KMS-wrapped writer. Monitor: auth failures, KMS decrypt errors, consumer lag.
- Full (19:30): roll cluster-wide if canary OK.
- Post (24h): rotate listed long-lived creds; schedule key rewrap 48h after if stable.

mei: RBAC diff preview: reduce `secrets` verbs to `get,list` and create `audit-writer` ServiceAccount with minimal pod/log access snippet attached in PR.

tony: Note: do NOT rewrap the key during cutover. I'll add a label `cutover=2026-06-10` and annotate owner.

alex: If >5% auth failures for 5m or >0.2% decrypt errors in consumer, rollback immediately. @ops will execute revert manifest. Ping this thread with PR links. :pray:
